# P5f: functional gate-level simulation, zero delay, cell models generated by Yosys from the liberty file
No SDF, no timing; NanGate45 typical (open PDK, not TSMC), pre-layout. No RTL change. RTL baba9e5 (tag rtl-v2-final);
flow synthesis/p5e + synthesis/p5 at 37c353c, ABC_BUDGET_PS=141.5 (netlists/FLOW_VERSION.txt). Netlists and models are not in git.
- Netlists: 12 (depth 16/64/256 x mode 0/1 x 1000/500 MHz), regenerated; hashes in netlists/netlists.sha256 equal
  results/P5e/new/netlists.sha256; all 20 cluster results print a netlist sha256 found in that file.
- Models: Yosys 0.33 `read_liberty -ignore_miss_func` (8 clock-gate cells ignored, models_ignored.txt); hashes of models and
  liberty in models.sha256. Cell check (CELLCHECK.md): 85 cells against the liberty functions, 84 PASS, 1 FAIL = DFFRS_X1
  (Yosys model bug: QN with clear and preset both low, no re-evaluation when RN rises with SN low). No netlist uses DFFRS_X1.
- Coverage (COVERAGE.md): 84 distinct cell types in the netlists, all with a model that passed the cell check; scan flops: none.
- Signal mapping: lockstep compares hit_flag, resp_valid, resp_data, fill_req, fill_addr every cycle after reset with !==;
  miss = resp_valid && !hit_flag. X check: XOR reduction === 1'bx on all outputs of both designs, every cycle
  ($isunknown gave false X reports in local Icarus 12 once the progress display was added; replaced, see tb comment).
